name: card_strip
text: A row of twelve white playing cards with light blue edges. Keep every card's rank, suit symbols, pip layout and the three face-card portraits exactly as they appear; make them sharp and clean.

name: kisebb_nagyobb
text: Two red signs: the left one reads 'KISEBB' and the right one reads 'NAGYOBB' (Hungarian). Keep the thin line of fine print below them as neat small text lines exactly where it is; do not invent readable words.

name: reel_1
text: A golden ornamental reel window showing three fruit-machine symbols on a white reel: a dark plum at the top, a yellow lemon in the middle and an orange at the bottom, each with a small playing-card tag on its right. Keep the tags' ranks exactly as shown.

name: reel_2
text: A golden ornamental reel window showing three fruit-machine symbols on a white reel: a watermelon slice at the top, a red star in the middle and an orange at the bottom, with small playing-card tags on the right. Keep the tags' ranks exactly as shown.

name: reel_3
text: A golden ornamental reel window showing three fruit-machine symbols on a white reel: a dark plum at the top, a red apple in the middle and a golden bell at the bottom, with small playing-card tags on the right. Keep the tags' ranks exactly as shown.

name: reel_4
text: A golden ornamental reel window showing three fruit-machine symbols on a white reel: a yellow lemon at the top, an orange in the middle and a 'BAR' sign at the bottom, with small playing-card tags on the right. Keep the tags' ranks exactly as shown.

name: kartya_kerek
text: A fan-shaped golden sign with the letters 'KÁRTYA' on the top line and 'KERÉK' below (Hungarian), above a small card window showing a red 'K' with a red diamond. Keep the small label below the window exactly as it appears.

name: tet_display
text: A blue LED display panel labelled 'TÉT' on the top left, showing cyan seven-segment digits, with three small yellow labels below reading 'NYEREMÉNY', 'BONUS BANK' and 'KREDIT'. Keep the digits exactly as shown and keep the thin fine-print line at the bottom as neat illegible lines.

name: kartya_oszto
text: A small red label reading 'KÁRTYA' on the first line and 'OSZTÓ' on the second line (Hungarian).
